samples: This module defines a small arithmetic expression tree with numbers, addition, multiplication, and negation. It can evaluate a tree to a decimal result and render it as fully parenthesized infix text. Its main program builds one sample expression and prints both the expression and its computed value, so it is useful as a simple example or demo rather than a general calculator.
